items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You remember Slucks and his Memphis Ramblers? [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know of him.

ctx.x: And let me see. Two or three other boys played guitar around here. But I just can't remember the name. They played with Jack Kelly. Will Betts. He played violin. And he's dead. Jack Kelly's dead.
You remember Slucks and his Memphis Ramblers?
